text:
olivia-design: Quick check on updated RBAC matrix + invite modal in Figma. Need UX + a11y nits before handing to eng.

mike-ux: looked through it. Main items: role inheritance UI is visually heavy; invite modal needs clearer expiry language. Also contrast on role chips fails AA at small sizes.

anna-product: flagging legal ask: explicit owner audit trail. Should we show Owner role in UI or hide behind a feature flag?

samir-eng: @anna-product we store owner events server-side. UI can hide, but need an explicit "View audit" action in the role detail so it's discoverable.

olivia-design: idea: add a small inline button on role rows: "View audit" -> opens audit log with ?filter=role:owner. Less clutter than extra column.

jess-security: fine but must be keyboard accessible and have an aria-label. Audit links should be shareable (include filter params). Also log invite creation events with expiry + role + creator id.

designbot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/rbac-invite-v4 (last frame = invite modal). Comments added for a11y checklist.

mike-ux: Invite copy suggestions:
- input label: "Invite teammates"
- helper: "Invitation link expires after 7 days. Resend or revoke anytime."
- primary button: "Send invite"

olivia-design: shortened helper to the above. Considering an "Advanced options" toggle to reveal expiry dropdown (1d/7d/30d/never) + role selector to keep modal compact.

anna-product: enterprise note: "never" should be disabled unless org has enterprise plan. Also product wants expiry dropdown surfaced for admins.

samir-eng: backend can support dropdown; prefer advanced options to avoid overwhelming users. Will add event schema: invite.created {creator_id, role, expiry_seconds}.

mike-ux: accessibility: use #0058d6 for role chip bg with white text, and increase focus outline on rows to 3px solid. Also ensure tooltip actions are reachable via Tab.

jess-security: SSO toggle copy: prefer "Require SAML SSO for organization sign-in. Admin bypass links allowed. Learn more." Include inline link to SSO docs.

olivia-design: will update copy and wire up link. Also adding a small checkbox in advanced options: "Require SSO for this invite" (security requested). Hide by default.

mike-ux: Audit log UX: allow saved filters (Invites, Role changes, SSO toggles) with a star to save and shareable URLs. Show retention banner: "Retention: 30 days (upgrade to 365 days available)" and an Export button.

samir-eng: saved filters require persisted per-org and a saved_filter API (CRUD). I'll spec endpoints in the API PR. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

olivia-design: will deliver two flows: 1) role detail panel with accessible "View audit" button, 2) compact invite modal with advanced options and updated microcopy. Adding a11y checklist to Figma comments.

anna-product: microcopy for email subject: "You’ve been invited to join <Org Name> on Redwood Inference" (explicit brand).

mike-ux: agree. Also note: make invite link expiration visible in invite list so admins can see pending invites and expiry.

jess-security: require audit fields for invites and role changes. Also confirm export format (CSV/JSON) for compliance.

olivia-design: thanks everyone. If no further bikeshedding, I'll hand mocks + copy + a11y notes to @samir-eng today. :thumbsup:

samir-eng: :thumbsup: watching for the PR.

last action: olivia-design pinned Figma link and tagged @anna-product.
